title: Chatbot aur AI Agent mein farak kya hai?
hooks: WhatsApp pe business se baat ki? Jawab aaya — par kaun de raha tha?
Chatbot sirf menu deta hai, AI agent samajhta hai — kaise?
Tera 24/7 digital employee jo kabhi sota nahi
hook_why: Relatable pain point in first 2 seconds: everyone has messaged a business on WhatsApp. Instant curiosity — was it human or AI? Visual: phone screen with notification + question mark, no jargon.
metaphor: The Neural Switchboard: one continuous camera push. WhatsApp bubble enters left → central AI brain pulses → golden context thread weaves through → three tool nodes (CRM, Calendar, Payment) light up right → reply bubble exits. No cuts, the move IS the explanation.

scenes.vo: WhatsApp pe business se baat ki? Jawab aaya — par kaun de raha tha?
scenes.prompt: Smartphone floating on pure black, WhatsApp notification visible, large glowing question mark over the chat, premium studio lighting
scenes.bg_prompt: Camera pushes into the notification, screen dissolves into neural particles

scenes.vo: Chatbot? Sirf menu. '1 dabao, 2 dabao.' Galat likha toh gadbad.
scenes.prompt: Rigid grey decision tree frozen in space, locked nodes, one red X over a typed 'helop', mechanical cold feel, photoreal on black
scenes.bg_prompt: Camera orbits slowly showing the tree cannot bend

real.q: Old style automated menu phone keypad 1 press 2 press screenshot
real.subject: A phone screen showing a rigid, text-based automated menu (1. Sales, 2. Support) to illustrate the pain point

scenes.vo: AI agent alag: LLM se samajhta hai — slang, typo, context sab.
scenes.prompt: WhatsApp bubble with messy text 'hey can u book appt 2moro?' glowing gold, fluid neural pathways lighting up around it, understanding as living connections, premium render on black
scenes.bg_prompt: Camera pulls back showing bubble absorbed into central glowing brain, gold context threads weaving

scenes.vo: Message aaya → LLM samjha → Context joda → Tool decide → Action → Jawab.
scenes.bg_prompt: One continuous camera push: WhatsApp bubble enters left → central brain pulses → golden thread weaves → three tool icons light up (CRM, Calendar, Payment) → reply bubble exits right, all photoreal on pure black

scenes.vo: Context yaad rakhta hai. Pehle 'dentist', phir 'kal 10 baje' — dono jod diya.
scenes.bg_prompt: Golden thread persisting through three WhatsApp bubbles entering brain, each bubble thickens the thread, final node triggers calendar icon, photoreal on black

scenes.vo: Tools: CRM, Calendar, Payment — ek saath, real-time.
scenes.title: Tools
scenes.bg_prompt: Central brain with three distinct glowing pathways to system nodes: CRM database, Calendar grid, Payment terminal, all premium photoreal on pure black

real.q: CRM dashboard calendar payment gateway integration screen

scenes.vo: Demo: 'Dentist book karo kal 10 baje' → 'Done, Dr. Sharma confirmed.'
scenes.bg_prompt: Real smartphone screen recording of WhatsApp chat showing the above exchange, floating on pure black with subtle studio lighting

real.subject: Real WhatsApp conversation showing AI agent booking appointment

scenes.vo: Apne docs se train — website, PDF, FAQ. Minute mein ready.
scenes.title: Auto Train
scenes.bg_prompt: Terminal window on black, code typing animation, final line glows gold, premium mono font render, no printed text on image

scenes.vo: 100+ bhasha, bina setup. Hindi, Tamil, English — sab automatic.
scenes.bg_prompt: Globe made of glowing WhatsApp bubbles, each bubble a different script (Devanagari, Tamil, Latin, Arabic), neural connections between them, premium render on black
scenes.title: Bhasha

scenes.bg_prompt: Brain node pulses orange, pathway opens to human headset icon, gold context thread passes along smoothly, photoreal on black

scenes.vo: Tera 24/7 digital employee — kabhi sota nahi.
scenes.bg_prompt: Central brain glowing steady, three tool nodes pulsing in rhythm, golden context thread looping infinitely, premium photoreal on pure black

scenes.vo: Tune kab AI agent se baat ki pata bhi nahi chala? Comment bata.
scenes.bg_prompt: Smartphone floating, WhatsApp icon glowing, keyboard sliding up with cursor blinking, inviting interaction, premium render on black

caption:
Chatbot ≠ AI Agent. Farak samjho 60 second mein. 🧠

WhatsApp pe business msg kiya? LLM samajhta hai, context yaad rakhta hai, CRM/Calendar/Payment se judta hai. 100+ bhasha, auto-train, human handoff — sab automatic.

Tune kab AI agent se baat ki pata bhi nahi chala? Comment bata 👇
